Scene:
古代，孟子跟孟母住在墓地的旁边。可是孟母注意，住在墓地的旁边影响孟子。他常常跟朋友们祭拜玩，所以孟母决定他们会搬家。这次，他们住在城市里的商店的旁边，从早到晚很吵。

The teacher's corrections on this scene:
- 古代，孟子跟孟母住在墓地的旁边：在古代，better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
- 可是孟母注意：注意到，注意action vs.注意到result
- 他常常跟朋友们祭拜玩：祭拜着玩儿，V.着玩儿 do something just for fun
- 所以孟母决定他们会搬家：决定搬家
- 从早到晚很吵：都很吵

The system's item in each run:
Run 1: 注意：注意到，When introducing a fact that someone came to notice, use the result complement in this verb pattern. [rule: none]
Run 2: 孟母注意：孟母注意到，The verb needs the result complement to express that she noticed the following situation. [rule: none]
Run 3: 孟母注意，住在墓地的旁边影响孟子：孟母注意到住在墓地的旁边会影响孟子，Use “注意到” when the character comes to realize an event or situation; “会” clearly marks the harmful consequence. [rule: none]

output.reason: All runs identify the missing result complement in “注意,” and each correction correctly changes it to “注意到” for the same issue.
